The '''Sancretti Arms Whip''' was a standard whip produced by [[Sancretti Arms & Munitions, Interstellar]]. Consisting of spun cables of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] hide, the whip measured four meters in length, and could deliver slashing attacks at range; a skilled user could also disarm or trip his opponent, though the weapon proved useless against even light armor.<ref name="GFT" />
